method: curl HTTPS GET, browser UA + Accept/Accept-Language, --compressed, forced UTF-8 decoding, NO session cookie (anonymous)
provenance: Sliced from a real anonymous mostaql.com project-detail capture (meta panel, skills, employer owner-widget, one bid-item).
scrubbing: Every visible free-text run (project title, description, bid previews, client display name, owner bio) is replaced with [text] or a placeholder; only whitelisted Arabic field labels and numeric/percent values are retained. Emails, avatar/CDN URLs, Sentry URLs, freelancer /u/ profile slugs, and any data-user-id are removed or neutralised. Verified programmatically: 0 emails, 0 hsoubcdn avatar URLs, 0 sentry hosts, 0 real /u/ slugs.
why_excerpt_not_full_page: The gate must prove the v4 selectors fire against real markup (D48) without committing a third party's personal content. Region slicing + text-only masking keeps the real DOM shape the selectors depend on.
